'''FC BGS''' БГС ({{langx|kk|Ақсай футбол клубы}}, ''Aqsaı fýtbol klýby'') were a [[Kazakhstan]]i [[Football (soccer)|football]] team based in [[Aksay, West Kazakhstan|Aqsay]], [[Kazakhstan]]. The club played in the [[Kazakhstan Super League]] in the 1993 season. They were members of the [[Kazakhstan First Division]] in 1994, but were not able to finish that season due to financial reasons. In 2002 they played in the [[Kazakhstan Second Division]].<ref>[http://www.lyakhov.kz/football/02/stand02-1.shtml Lyakhov.kz: Season 2002] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071113151808/http://www.lyakhov.kz/football/02/stand02-1.shtml |date=2007-11-13 }} {{in lang|ru}}</ref>"}}
